wiki.title: Cracked Claw
wiki.text:
The Cracked Claw is a cray NPC boss that can be found in the Cracked Claw Caverns, located in Blackspore Swamp. He is the ancient cray, and the leader of the Blackspore cray. The cray in the Cracked Claw Caverns are extremely aggressive lately, it is up to the player to come and defeat the Cracked Claw to lessen the cray' aggressive nature.
